decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical international information structure.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
COMMAND TSPC includes intnat.inc and allocates INTERNATVARS as internat_block padded to internat_block_max.
The previous TSPC layout investigation compared 3924 unchanged reference bytes against the inferred target layout after accounting for 14 inserted COPY-state bytes (review 162).
limitations: The TSPC layout comparison relies on inferred data bases and does not establish semantic values of every uninitialized field. Country data, final COMMAND.COM linkage and whole-file identity remain unverified.
